answer_2.quote: We define the faithfulness to be the Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence of rule-related distributions from training and test sets. ... We adopted the same metrics as to evaluate the recommendation performance of all models: Precision, Recall, Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (NDCG), and Hit Rate (HR).

answer_4.quote: We conduct a user study to evaluate the faithfulness of the explainable paths. ... We ask 20 human subjects to rank these methods based on whether the generated paths are consistent with those from the training set.
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluators were asked to rank each method according to the consistency of its generated explanation paths with the user's historic behavior shown in training data.
